fact: Togo First says Togo AI Lab is developing models that understand and generate content in several Togolese languages, within a national local-languages project using LLMs, RAG and AI agents.

Togo AI Lab, with Zindi and the Togolese startup Umbaji, is building an open-source platform to collect voice and text data, aiming for at least 50 hours of validated recordings and 6,000 translated sentence pairs for each of 50 national languages, to train speech recognition, speech synthesis and translation models, as presented at AI for Good in July 2026.

UNDP says it deployed country-hosted AI compute capacity in Togo under its AI Infrastructure Activation programme.
